name: Incident — 1 Day (Basic Response)
description: Simple single-day incident response template. Covers detection through initial containment. Suitable for quick incident simulations, tabletops, and short response drills.

items.title: INCIDENT DETECTED
items.description: Initial detection or report. Document detection method, time, and source.

items.title: Initial Assessment
items.description: First assessment of scope and severity. Classify the incident.

items.title: Incident Commander Notified
items.description: IC formally notified and assumes command.

items.title: Response Team Activated
items.description: Response team assembled and briefed on initial situation.

items.title: Management Notified
items.description: Senior management informed of incident. Escalation path confirmed.

items.title: Containment Actions Begin
items.description: Immediate containment measures implemented to limit spread or impact.

items.title: Evidence Collection
items.description: Preserve logs, artefacts, and forensic evidence before it is lost.

items.title: Situation Report #1
items.description: First formal SITREP to management and stakeholders.

items.title: Root Cause Analysis Begins
items.description: Technical team investigates root cause of the incident.

items.title: Situation Report #2
items.description: Updated SITREP. Include containment status and initial findings.

items.title: Decision: Escalate or De-escalate
items.description: IC decision point on whether to escalate resources or move to recovery.

items.title: Recovery Actions Begin
items.description: Systems and processes restored following containment.

items.title: Final Situation Report
items.description: Closing SITREP. Incident status, actions taken, next steps.

items.title: INCIDENT CLOSED
items.description: Incident formally closed. Transition to lessons-learned review.
